blocks.title: Results in this paper
blocks.content:
The goal of this paper is to generalise Roth's theorem  in a wider framework which includes Corvaja's and Vojta's settings.

The theory of  adelic curves introduced by Chen and Moriwaki in \cite{Ch-Mo} provides such natural framework:  an adelic curve $\mathbb X$ consists of a field $\mathbb K$ of characteristic $0$ and a measure space $(\Omega,\mathcal A, \mu)$ endowed with a function  $\phi:\omega\mapsto \vert\cdot \vert_{\omega}$ that maps $\Omega$ into the set of places of $\mathbb K$ and such that $\omega\mapsto\log|a|_\omega$ is  in $L^1(\Omega,\mu)$ for any $a\in\mathbb K^\times$.
